reel.title: From terminal capture to polished Reel — in one command

shots.label: Snapped hit points on the beats

narration.text: You shipped something, and the demo video is eating your day.
One command reads a terminal and designs the whole video.
It parses the cast and finds the moments that matter.
Every line is synthesized and measured before a shot is fixed.
The result is a real, editable reel, not a flat mp4.
Music is where this gets genuinely hard.
Three candidates, three tempos, and the one that lands wins.
The cuts snap onto the beats the music really has.
The report shows why it won.
And you don't just get the video.
You get the timeline, cuts marked where the beats are.
It opens in any tool that speaks OTIO, including Final Cut.
Render, assemble, and the shot report lands beside the mp4.
The timeline round-trips through a real stats tool.
h264, 1920 by 1080, ready for the README.
Tests and the build gate are green before anything ships.
Free, MIT, and the first run needs no API key.

music.caption: LaunchReel promo — confident, developer-focused underscore with a clear pulse for cut points.

advisories: the narration totals 1088 characters against a budget of 945 — 143 over. Cut whole sentences rather than trimming every line: the reel is stretched to fit whatever is written, so going over does not make it denser, it makes it longer and holds shots on a frozen frame.
